text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before training, Sounds of Earth was 
engrossed in reading a novel.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent piece of work...! 
Stupendo...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Star-crossed amore... Yearning, slowly 
losing your mind... Falling into a 
lamentabile, my dear...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The motifs... The new musical phrases... 
They're washing over me like waves.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...It's no good! No matter how much I 
write down, it's not enough...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(To give form to this surging passionato, 
the only way is to actually play it!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The endless tragedy played fortissimo! The 
burning spirit of revenge con fuoco!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Make the legato of tragic love even more 
delicate! A touch of happiness... to an 
unrequited soul!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth followed her heart and 
kept on playing music, skipping her 
training altogether in the process.
